name: TikTok TV Clean Player
description: Removes login walls and clutter from TikTok for clean video viewing on TV

params.css: [class*='DivLoginModal'], [class*='LoginModal'], [id*='login-modal'], [class*='BottomBanner'], [data-e2e='download-app-banner'], [class*='DivBannerWrapper'] { display: none !important; } body, html { overflow: auto !important; position: static !important; } [class*='DivVideoWrapper'] video { max-height: 90vh !important; } [class*='DivCommentContainer'], [class*='DivSideActionBar'] { font-size: 16px !important; } [class*='DivDescription'] { font-size: 18px !important; }

params.code: document.querySelectorAll('[class*="Modal"], [class*="modal"]').forEach(function(el) { var t = el.textContent; if (t.includes('Log in') || t.includes('Sign up') || t.includes('download')) el.remove(); }); return 'done';
